note: Every source this cycle relied on, whether it was actually opened, and what it does and does not support.

sources.title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season
sources.supports: Per-player weekly report rows for the 28 clubs in the Week 10 slate: player name (linked), position code, injury text, practice status, game status. Also the week's game list with day, kickoff, broadcast and each club's win-loss-tie record as of the page read, and the NEWS module headlines.
sources.does_not_support: Depth ordering, roster status (IR/PUP/NFI), inactive lists, practice-squad players, or any price. The report omits clubs with no game that week, so absence from it is not absence of injury. Records on this page are as-of-page-read and moved after the Thursday game.

sources.title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season
sources.supports: That the unqualified injury URL resolves to the current week (Week 10 of 2026 on the capture date) and offers a season and week selector from 1965 to 2026 and WEEK 1 to WEEK 10.
sources.does_not_support: Anything historical: only the resolved current week was read.

sources.title: NFL Week 10 injury report: Player statuses for all 14 games
sources.supports: Per-club OUT / DOUBTFUL / QUESTIONABLE lists for 26 of the 28 clubs in the slate, with the position label and injury text as printed; each game's venue, kickoff time, broadcast partner and official game-centre URL; each club's record as printed in the article header.
sources.does_not_support: Practice participation, and any designation for the Monday game (LAC at BAL): that block prints venue, kickoff and broadcast only. The article's own header states it tracks 'all 14 games', so a reader who treats a missing club as 'no injuries' will be wrong. See flag F04.

sources.title: NFL news roundup: Latest league updates from Friday, Nov. 13
sources.supports: Club-by-club INJURIES, SIGNINGS, ROSTER CUTS and DEPTH CHART NEWS items for the clubs the article covered, including head-coach statements that name a replacement starter (MIN, SEA) and report a ruling-out (HOU, SEA).
sources.does_not_support: Clubs the roundup omits (CHI, LAC, NYG, TB are absent from the Friday roundup). Absence is recorded as absence, never as 'no news'. Practice status per player and any price.

sources.title: NFL Scores and Highlights - Week 10, 2026
sources.supports: The Week 10 slate: 14 games with kickoff dates and records; the Thursday result Commanders 24, Giants 21 (Final); and the explicit line 'Teams on Bye' naming CHI (7-2), DEN (7-2), PHI (2-7), TB (3-6).

sources.title: Competition Committee approves revisions to injury report
sources.supports: Official definitions, as published on the page: Practice Report lists injured players as Did Not Participate, Limited Participation (less than 100 percent of a player's normal repetitions) or Full Participation (100 percent); the 'Out' category was eliminated from the Practice Report. Game Status Report: Questionable means it is uncertain as to whether the player will play; Doubtful means it is unlikely the player will participate; Out means the player will not play. 'Probable' was eliminated because approximately 95 percent of players listed Probable played. If a player is certain to play the player will no longer be listed in the club's Game Status Report; a such a player who is then deactivated requires an explanation to the league and possible discipline.
sources.does_not_support: Its own currency. The page body retrieved on 2026-11-13 carries no publication date and no 'current policy' statement, so this session treats the wording as a documented Competition Committee revision, not as proof of the rule in force in 2026. Flag F02, question Q02.

sources.title: line_lab/data/derived/summary.json - protocol, 11 strategies, correlations, luck band, power table
sources.supports: The published protocol (edge_min 0.03, price bounds -125 to +400, evaluation window 2006-2025, holdout 2023-2025, 2000 bootstrap and 2000 permutation resamples, seed 20261101, FDR level 0.10), per-strategy gate results, same-game phi estimates, the luck band and the power table. Recomputed, not re-typed: desk/build_ledger.py derives the ledger from this file and desk/check.py re-runs the derivation. sources.does_not_support: Any official status. The prices behind these numbers come from a pinned third-party dataset (R05), not from the league.

link_families.why: An individual profile page. Rows link it to show where a player's identity and position come from; the substance of a row still comes from the report or article that registered source covers.
The weekly report at a specific week slug, which is the same publisher and page family A01 registers.
Files in this repository, including this desk's own registers. A count of a register may cite the register.

link_family_note: A row's source must be one of the registered IDs above or a URL inside one of these families, and check.py enforces both. The families exist so that a per-row link to a player profile is understood as an identity reference rather than as a claim that someone opened and recorded every profile - which this desk cannot say.
